title: Did  not stick to my porcelain tile after cleaning it!
text:
Did not stick to my porcelain tile after cleaning it!. When I saw this, I’m thinking what a great idea for when I color my hair, I can make sure with the
second shampooing all the color dye is washed away.
That was wishful thinking!
My bathroom has porcelain 12 inch tiles in the shower, that are a few years old.
I scrubbed it with comet cleanser, washed it after, wiped it dry, and waited till night to try and push this on the Tile!
No way was this staying on the smooth porcelain tile. It just kept falling off.
Thank goodness the mirror is a type of plastic that does not break.

I like the idea this can hold two razors,but since it would not stay on the tile, I’m going to try anf lean it against the window in
My shower, but if I do, the razors holder cannot be used!

I notice for some people this did stick to there shower wall, I would love the known how this can stick to anything!
Btw, this is small but adequate
Giving this a two star , as the idea is good, and so is the price if it works for you.

product_metadata.title: InterDesign Power Cling Wall Mount Silicone, Rectangular Shaving Mirror & Razor Holder for Bathroom Shower Storage-Teal Mirror
features: INSTANT STORAGE – A mirror surface combined with two storage hooks for razors holds daily essentials in one handy bath accessory

STRONG HOLD – Securely grips to any clean, dry, smooth, non-porous surfaces in the bathroom, on kitchen appliances like the fridge, in the office including metal filing cabinets or school and gym lockers; No adhesives or suction cups needed; Stays put even when wet!
EASY INSTALLATION – Just remove clear backing and apply silicone to a clean, dry and flat surface; Razor holders keep a strong grip around razor heads
DURABLE – Made of durable, teal-colored silicone; Backing acts as its own suction to hold the mirror in place
description: The Power Cling Wall Mount Shaving Mirror by InterDesign works well in shower spaces and anywhere in the bathroom to make daily grooming convenient. Sleek styling with a soothing, teal colored silicone add a modern look to this handy bathroom accessory. Featuring two razor hooks, this mirror mounts to a wall by simply removing the clear film from the back and applying it to any shiny bathroom surface, either inside or outside the shower, like marble, glass surfaces, fiberglass or metal to create instant storage for your daily necessities.
